title: IsntLessCommands
description: This project does not add less commands, it adds the oppisite, MORE COMMANDS, its for isnt_dressy server so thats why theres a weird name
body:
This Mod adds 4 new commands just for fun, this was made for the isnt_dressy server but you can use it for whatever

All Commands:
1. /explode [power]
Explodes you with a specified power amount (permission level: 2)
2. /fakechat [username] [text]
Sends a fake chat message that looks like anyone you want (permission level: 3)
3. /createcolorteams
Creates color teams so you can color your username (permission level: 2)
4. /chorus
acts like a chorus fruit but worse because it doesnt change your Y pos (permission level: 2)
